item.title: Morocco Starts Mapping 16,160 Hectares of Tribal Land
item.description: Six decrees schedule boundary-mapping of about 16,160 hectares of collective land from 28 December 2026. Also: OCP gets two 100%-owned logistics subsidiaries, Allianz Maroc is absorbed by Sanlam, and a 25 km national road widening is renewed.

item.title: Morocco Greenlights Land for New High-Speed Rail Line to Marrakech
item.description: This week’s Official Gazette: land cleared for the Kénitra–Marrakech high-speed line, a nationwide university expansion, new refurbished-medical-device rules, and 25,000+ hectares of tribal land formally recognized.

item.title: Morocco Is Embedding Judges in Its Embassies to Speed Up Diaspora Cases
item.description: Morocco will station liaison judges in its diplomatic missions to follow cross-border civil, family and criminal cases. Also in issue 7513: a customs reorganisation, 13,470 hectares of tribal land fixed in law, and a new dam in Safi.
